scope: New unsigned packaged frameless Desktop and real native Chrome Side Panel with actual identity, scoped synthetic website collection, tenant-bound native evidence/report saves, actual locked Codex process and preserved supplier synchronization. Web, Desktop and native Side Panel use explicit synthetic paid input turns, retain human selections across actual task refreshes and clear prior content after current reads are denied. No public website/TLS, installation, store publication or production qualification.
